plan.problem: Race condition in add() causes data loss with concurrent writes - TOCTOU vulnerability in load/calculate-id/save sequence
plan.solution: File locking using fcntl.flock via exclusive_access() context manager
plan.approach: TDD - failing test first, then implementation

implementation.description: Added exclusive_access() context manager to TodoStorage using fcntl.flock for thread-safe file locking. The add() method in TodoApp now uses this context manager to prevent race conditions during load-modify-save operations.
